title: CodePipeline, CodeBuild and CodeDeploy: the native chain

videos.script: The deploy worked. That is where this course begins. {{deploy}} After the deploy comes everything else. A pipeline that ships the next change. A metric that says the shop is slow before a customer does. A key nobody should read, and a bill at the end of the month. {{course}} You will practise all of it on your own computer. A program called moto answers like AWS, and the real AWS command line talks to it. There is no account, and nothing is billed. {{moto}} moto answers like AWS. It enforces much less. A build it runs has run nothing. An alarm it stores never fires. Every time that matters, the lesson says so. {{honest}} This first lesson builds the lab, then the chain that delivers code: CodePipeline, CodeBuild and the bucket between them. {{chain}} By the end, you can read a pipeline as a list of files passed from step to step. You will also know which role each step wears, and why the build's role should be the smallest. {{end}}
